dataset_info.description: Final part of the VEDA disease database from Volume 2. Completes the full disease list (Splenomegaly through Wound) and includes the complete Sanskrit Medical Terminology Master Index with all 317 terms from Dravyaguna Vijnana Vol. 2.

diseases.description: Abnormal enlargement of the spleen. Volume 2 lists Amlavetasa, Amra, Arka, Badari, Guduchi, Karanja and Kumari — bitter, blood-purifying and Pitta-reducing herbs.
Heat stroke from excessive sun exposure. Volume 2 lists Adhaki, Amalaki, Amra and Cinca.
Suppressed or obstructed urine flow. Volume 2 adds Ela, Kantakari and Kunkuma to Amalaki and Aragvadha.
Sexually transmitted infection from Treponema pallidum. Volume 2 lists Copacini (Smilax china) and Akarakarabha — both used in classical treatment of venereal diseases.

General poisoning from various toxins. Volume 2 adds Aralu, Arimeda, Asvattha, Ativisa, Bandhuka, Carmakasa, Coraka, Hamsapadi, Jati, Jimutaka, Jivanti, Kapittha, Khadira, Krsnavetra, Mallika, Mamsi, Mudgaparni, Mustaka — expanding to 19 antidote herbs.

Excessive or pathological thirst (Trishna) from Pitta or heat aggravation, or metabolic disease. Volume 2 adds Asvattha, Dhanyaka, Karpasa, Karpura, Kasmarya, Kola, Laghu-pancamula, Mudga, Mudgaparni, Munjataka and Mustaka.
Group of abdominal disorders including ascites and abdominal enlargement. Volume 2 adds Canaka, Cavica, Dravanti, Jyotismati, Kakadani, Kodrava, Manat-pancamula, Manaka, Mandukaparni and Nilini.
